title: A face swap put my face on something above me 🙂
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark moody blue-teal grade, one bright light source, well exposed, 35mm film grain, realistic, no text, no watermark, no faces
hook_text: At 1:05 a.m. a face swap filter put my face on something above me.

scenes.narration: At 1:05 a.m. a face swap filter put my face on something above me.

shots.prompt: dark bedroom ceiling with a faint pale smudge, phone glow below, no person

scenes.narration: I was playing with a face swap filter. It swaps your face with whatever the camera sees. A cat. A statue. A friend.

shots.prompt: hand holding a phone in a dark bedroom, bright screen glow, no face

scenes.narration: I pointed it at the poster on my wall. The swap worked. My face, on a poster. I laughed.

shots.prompt: phone camera pointing at a dark bedroom wall with a poster, bright screen, no face

scenes.narration: Then I tilted the phone up. The filter locked onto something near the ceiling. A tiny spinning circle. Face found.

shots.prompt: phone screen with a glowing circle pointing at the dark ceiling of a bedroom, no text

scenes.narration: My face appeared on the screen, hanging upside down, pressed against the ceiling. It was smiling. I was not.

shots.prompt: dim bedroom ceiling with a pale oval shape pressed against it, no face

scenes.narration: I lowered the phone. The ceiling looked normal. Plain white paint. Raised the phone. The face was gone from the screen.

shots.prompt: plain white bedroom ceiling in dim light, no person

scenes.narration: A drop landed on the screen. Another landed on my cheek. I did not look up. I just watched the filter in the phone.

shots.prompt: phone screen with water drops on it and a glowing circle, dim room, no text

scenes.narration: The filter had found a face again. Right behind mine. Close enough that I could feel the breath on my neck.

shots.prompt: bedroom wall in a phone camera view with a pale shape behind a silhouette, no face

scenes.narration: And the swap finished. For a moment, I could see the room from above.

shots.prompt: dark bedroom seen from the ceiling looking down at a bed and a phone glow, no person

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you look up, or keep your eyes on the phone?

shots.prompt: dark bedroom ceiling with a faint pale smudge, phone glow below, no person
